paper.title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
paper.central_claim: A framework that interactively searches for language sequences that improve closed-loop VLA task performance, distills them into a test-time language feedback policy (LFP), and learns a conformalized improvement head that predicts when language steering will improve performance; on arbitrary frozen pre-trained VLAs it improves base VLA performance by 24.7% in simulation and 65.0% in hardware on seen environments, with harmlessness guarantees on visual and semantic perturbations with calibration samples, and produces recovery behaviors not observed with open-loop prompting.
paper.scope_note: 在范围内(训练的 VLM 作为冻结 VLA 的上层、教师模型 GPT-5.4/Molmo2 参与离线搜索)；属 component_training，边界偏窄但可接受

signatures.object: 语言反馈策略 LFP(Qwen3-VL-4B+LoRA)：每个重规划步向冻结 VLA(π0.5-LIBERO/DROID，MolmoAct2) 输出语言'动作'
signatures.information: LFP 看腕/第三视角 RGB 与任务指令；训练侧：Molmo2-8B 叙述(无动作标签)、GPT-5.4 释义、仿真/真机二元任务成功；VLA 权重与训练数据不可见

signatures.conditions: 仅在 Visual-Viewpoint 训练环境搜索与训练；基座近饱和时无增益空间；VLA 不可转向则无益
signatures.feedback: 闭环 rollouts 的二元成功；与基座指令的差分
signatures.selection_rule: 最高 Δ̂ 的序列(sim: 16×25 + top8×75 rollouts)；RFT 仅用被选序列的成功演示
signatures.persistence: LFP 的 LoRA 权重；改进头参数
signatures.later_use: 在训练环境、留出视觉环境、语义改写、新组合与新硬件任务上部署；也作用于 MolmoAct2
signatures.claimed_effect: 训练环境成功 51.2→63.9；比 VLA-SFT 更省微调数据且 OOD 不降；闭环优于开环
signatures.failure_boundary: 留出视觉场景增益≈0 或负(RFT -1.3pp)；Compose 中16–22号全0；Microwave 不可转向

signatures.object: 是否使用 LFP 的门控：改进头 ψ + 类别条件保形阈值 q̂α

assessment.evidence_level_reason: 依据 docs/EVIDENCE.md：硬件闭环试验给出每任务/条件次数(30)，且包含未参与叙述/搜索/训练的两个硬件任务(MarkerBowl、ChipsCup)的闭环成功提升；仿真另有留出视觉场景。限制：单一机型、近邻任务、留出仿真场景增益≈0。
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 以冻结 π0.5(LIBERO 仿真与 DROID Franka 硬件)为基座，一个 4B VLM 的语言反馈策略(叙述预训练+基座上闭环搜索选出的释义做 RFT)可显著提高训练环境及两个近邻未见硬件任务的成功率(sim 51.2→63.9；硬件未见任务+40~50pp，n=30)，在已饱和的留出仿真场景上增益≈0 到 +2.6pp；类别条件保形阈值在与校准同类的扰动上将有害转向比率压到≈α；相对 VLA-SFT 的样本效率优势未按交互预算匹配。
not_supported: 对任意冻结 VLA 的普适性
超出校准分布的无害性

assessment.aggregate_note: sol's Appendix 6.3 'tie counterexample' reviewed: the proof states uniformity 'up to ties' (agg:E001) and the score is a continuous MLP output (agg:E002); ties have probability zero, so this is a minor caveat, not an open flaw. The material limits are exchangeability with the calibration distribution (agg:E003) and harm labels from noisy empirical improvement.

G.reason: gap 具体：VLA 语言→行为映射脆弱且不直观，朴素提示/零样本 LM 常失败，部分行为不可由语言引出，开放词表使穷举搜索不可行，转向在分布偏移下可能有害。附录A.1把最近邻分三类并写出差异(提示优化未蒸馏、分层方法依赖人类反馈/示范、测试时 steering 方法)，局限段给出残余缺口(局部搜索、保证只在校准分布)。扣分：与提示优化/验证器类测试时 steering 未做同协议实验比较，这些最近邻全文不在输入包内。

M.reason: 机制可重建且有可区分预测：(i) 冻结 VLA 已含低层技能，语言是更高抽象的控制杆；(ii) 局部搜索+RFT 把搜索结果摊销为闭环策略；(iii) 预测'是否可改进'比预测'说什么'容易，故只对改进头做保形校准。预测可检：叙述SFT不够(已验证，E020)、闭环>开环(E019)、拒绝降低有害转向(E042)。假设薄弱点：改进头仅看初始状态而 LFP 逐步闭环；时间索引的搜索序列与闭环部署的训练-部署失配未讨论；语言是否利用 VLA 的伪相关未检验。

initial_evidence_judgment: Read in full before seat reasons. A Qwen3-VL-4B language feedback policy (LFP) steers frozen VLAs (pi0.5-LIBERO, pi0.5-DROID, MolmoAct2) by issuing language at each replan; trained by narration SFT (Molmo2 narrations of base-VLA videos), interactive search over GPT-5.4 paraphrases scored by closed-loop Monte Carlo improvement, and RFT; a regression improvement head on o_0, conformalized on harmful calibration episodes, decides once per episode whether to steer. In scope (frontier teacher offline, frozen VLA as executor, trained VLM high level). Evidence: LIBERO-OOD 50 rollouts x 200 combos (env-checked), Franka hardware 30 trials/condition, novel hardware tasks (30->80, 33->73), confusion matrices for the gate, OL/phrase/trajectory ablation, second VLA. Weaknesses: held-out sim scenes saturated (gains ~0 to +2.6 pp, mostly from CP), calibration drawn from the same perturbation combinations as test, search budget (~1000 rollouts/task-env) not charged against VLA-SFT in the sample-efficiency claim, no training-seed variance. Likely transfer (unseen hardware tasks), claim scoped.
